rejected.title: Get guidance on a rejected workflow template
rejected.reason: The reread discussion only requests guidance on a template submission rejected three times. It supplies no concrete workflow chore, required output, inputs or recurring task. Scoping an AI service to diagnose or rewrite the submission would invent duties and validation rules, so there is no supported narrow experiment to score.

steps.message: No post proposed: the sole assigned discussion asks for template-submission guidance but does not identify a concrete operational chore that can be scoped without inventing duties.
